blocks.title: Después de este pdf sabrás
bullets: formar la voz pasiva con be + participio
usarla en present, past, present perfect y con verbos modales
usar have / get something done (mandar hacer algo)

blocks.text: La voz pasiva (passive) se forma con una forma de be más el participio. El tiempo está en be; el participio no cambia.

head: Tiempo
Ejemplo
Español
rows: The results will be published tomorrow.

blocks.title: se habla = is spoken
blocks.text: El español usa mucho el se (se habla inglés, se vende piso) o la tercera persona del plural (me han robado la bici). El inglés usa la pasiva con be: English is spoken here, Flat for sale o A flat is being sold, My bike has been stolen. Nunca Here speaks English ni Is spoken English.

items: Cuando no importa quién lo hace: The rubbish is collected on Mondays.
Cuando no lo sabes: My car was stolen last night.
Cuando es evidente: He was arrested. (por la policía)
En textos formales, noticias y ciencia: The tests were carried out in May.

blocks.text: Si aun así quieres decir quién lo hace, usa by (por): Hamlet was written by Shakespeare. The window was broken by a ball.

blocks.title: Preguntas y negaciones
blocks.text: Las mismas reglas que con be: Was it made in China? It wasn't made in China. When was it built? Has the room been cleaned?
Cuando otra persona hace algo por ti (normalmente pagando), se usa have o get + complemento + participio. get es más informal.

head: Inglés
Español
rows: I had my hair cut yesterday.
Ayer me corté el pelo (en la peluquería).
You should get your car checked.
Deberías llevar el coche a revisar.

blocks.title: Me corté el pelo = I had my hair cut
blocks.text: Me corté el pelo suele significar en español que lo hizo el peluquero. En inglés se dice entonces I had my hair cut. I cut my hair significa que lo hiciste tú mismo.

rows: This book was written from Orwell.
This book was written by Orwell.
I cut my hair at the hairdresser's.
I had my hair cut at the hairdresser's.
Mandar hacer algo: have something done.
Pasiva después de un verbo modal: be + participio.

blocks.text: Completa con la voz pasiva. Las respuestas están en la última página.

items.full: This cheese is made in France.
The Eiffel Tower was built in 1889.

items.q: My wallet ______. I can't find it!
items.full: My wallet has been stolen. I can't find it!
The new hospital will be opened next year.
The road is being repaired at the moment.

items.q: This song was written ______ John Lennon.
items.full: This song was written by John Lennon.

items.q: The homework must ______ handed in on Friday.
items.full: The homework must be handed in on Friday.
I'm having my car serviced tomorrow.

items.q: She ______ her hair cut last week.
items.full: She had her hair cut last week.
The rooms are cleaned every day.

items.q: Two people ______ injured in the accident.
items.full: Two people were injured in the accident.

items.q: Ayer me corté el pelo en la peluquería.
items.a: I had my hair cut yesterday.
